qualityGate.reason: The Playwright tests compile and use Playwright APIs mostly correctly. Await is present on all asynchronous assertions. There are no direct iterations over Locator. Test titles preserve the testCaseId. However, the selectors appear to be weak and potentially brittle since they use a static data-test attribute for product listing and navigation, with the first test expecting exactly 26 elements which could be unstable. Also, the URL validation after click in TC-003 is weak as it expects any URL containing '/product/1', which might pass if redirected unexpectedly. No hard-coded waits or placeholder URLs are found. There are no test cases missing for generated test cases. The code is straightforward but could improve on selector strategy and navigation assertion strength.
